title: test(plugin-chatbot): the pending-count pulse pin waits for the count render, not for the button
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xWykojkGiiPqmQgGV32BZcw)_
Fixes #26647

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改一个测试文件。草稿卡「发布 (N)」的计数断言,改成等到计数渲染出来再读,不再在按钮刚出现那一刻读文字。产品代码零改动。
- 为什么改:按钮先画出来,待发布数量是随后异步读回、下一次渲染才带上的。旧断言在按钮出现时就读,机器一忙就读到「发布」而不是「发布 (2)」,已两次把合并队列里的 PR 踢出去。
- 风险与回滚:极低,只动测试;回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.pendingCountPulse-26471.test.tsx` 里新增的 `expectPublishButtonText` 和它替换掉的两处 `findByTestId` 一次性断言。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.pendingCountPulse-26471.test.tsx`,预期 2 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ChatbotEnhanced.pendingCountPulse-26471.test.tsx` only. Both tests read the draft card's count as

```ts
expect(await screen.findByTestId('draft-publish')).toHaveTextContent('发布 (2)');
```

and now read it through one helper, `expectPublishButtonText`, which is a `waitFor` around the same `getByTestId('draft-publish')` + `toHaveTextContent` assertion. Nothing else in the file moves: the call counts, the pulse leg, the unmount leg and every expected string are byte-identical. `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` is untouched.

## Why

The draft card draws its publish button in the same render as the card. At that moment `fetchPendingDraftCount` has not answered, `livePendingCount` is `undefined`, and the button reads `发布` with no count. The count reaches the DOM on a second render, committed when the read resolves and `setPendingByPackage` lands. `findByTestId` resolves on its first check that finds the button, which is the first render, so the one-shot `toHaveTextContent` that follows races the second render. On an idle box that render usually lands first; under load it sometimes does not, and the assertion reads `发布`.

That is exactly what the queue saw. Both ejections (queue runs 40468287272 and 40493270857) failed `unmount unsubscribes: a later pulse reads nothing` with `Expected element to have text content: 发布 (2) / Received: 发布`, at that test's opening `findByTestId('draft-publish')` assertion, before any pulse fires in it.

**The count is not wrong** (triage asked to read the red as real until shown otherwise): the button shows no count while the count is unknown and `发布 (2)` once it is known, which is the component's stated design ("Leave the package unknown — the card falls back to the in-memory snapshot rather than guessing"). The pin now waits for the render that carries the count instead of the render that carries the button. No sleep, retry, skip, timeout change or quarantine.

## Tests

All local, on this branch's head `b192892a` unless marked `origin/main` (`f6ffd723`); 4-core container, so absolute durations are shared-box figures.

- **Reproduced on `origin/main` under load:** 24 runs of the unchanged file with 6 CPU busy-loops: 23 passed, **1 failed** in `unmount unsubscribes` with `Received: 发布`, the queue's signature byte for byte.
- **Fix under the same load** (plus a gate sweep running beside it): 24 runs, **24 passed**, 0 failed.
- **Deterministic reverse check** (scratch file, deleted after the run, never committed): with a `fetchPendingDraftCount` that answers 30 ms later, the old pin fails every time (`Received: 发布`) and the new pin passes.
- **The new pin still catches a wrong count:** with the count suffix removed from the button in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`), both tests go red with `Received: 发布`; restored, blob equals `HEAD` (`2233fd2f`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/`: 86 files, 816 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check`: exit 0; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists this test file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Mechanism hypothesis, measured.** The dispatch guessed the red line races the *pulse's* re-render. The red is real and load-dependent, but it races the *first count read's* re-render: the failing assertion runs before the test fires any pulse. The pulse leg in the first test is wrapped in `await act(...)`, which flushes that update before the assertions after it, and was never the red line.
- **No same-class sibling here.** In `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src`, a one-shot text assertion straight after a `findBy*` occurs only at these two calls. The other suite that wires `fetchPendingDraftCount` (`ChatbotEnhanced.changeCardV2-12894`) reads the count inside `await act(...)`.
- **No changeset, `skip-changeset` instead.** The diff is one test file. `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `LICENSE`. After a build, `dist` holds 0 hits for `expectPublishButtonText` or `unmount unsubscribes`, and 2 files for the positive control `draft-publish`. So nothing publishes, and a patch changeset would put a test-only line in the released CHANGELOG.
- `origin/main` gained one commit after this branch's base (`43731031`, `ui/packages/auth` only), outside this package's dependency closure; not merged in.
